qa_pairs.question: How many fuel injectors are shown in this wiring diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Four fuel injectors are shown, labeled as NO. 1, NO. 2, NO. 3, and NO. 4.

qa_pairs.question: What wire color and gauge connects to the fuel injectors from the main relay?
qa_pairs.answer: .75 RD/WT (0.75mm red/white wire) connects from the main relay to all four fuel injectors.

qa_pairs.question: What are the terminal numbers for the air flow meter connector?
qa_pairs.answer: The air flow meter has terminals numbered 22, 6, 7, 2, and 3.

qa_pairs.question: What important warning is displayed regarding the air flow meter?
qa_pairs.answer: DO NOT MEASURE RESISTANCE AT TERMINAL 9 is the warning shown for the air flow meter.

qa_pairs.question: What are the two throttle switch positions shown?
qa_pairs.answer: The throttle switch shows CLOSED THROTTLE INPUT and WIDE OPEN THROTTLE INPUT positions.

qa_pairs.question: What wire gauge and color connects the barometric pressure sensor to the motronic control unit?
qa_pairs.answer: .75 WT (0.75mm white wire) connects the barometric pressure sensor to the motronic control unit.

qa_pairs.question: Which ground points are referenced in this diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Ground points G101 and G103 are referenced in this wiring diagram.

qa_pairs.question: What wire colors are used for the fuel injector control signals?
qa_pairs.answer: The fuel injector control signals use .75 BR/WT (brown/white) and .75 BR/YL (brown/yellow) wires.
